t: DEWALT 6.35mm hex shank mixed drill driver set delivers key fastening and drilling solutions for multiple onsite jobs. Ideal for tradespeople and construction workers, the 25-piece high-grade accessory set can be used for daily workshop or site tasks. Supplied with a small Toughcase to keep all 25 pieces organised and secure. Compatible with DEWALT TSTAK caddy.
